findings: VIVI selected as first Phuket supply acceptance path because a current first-party project route and private project-specific WET agency evidence both exist.
Private VIVI commercial documents were reviewed without copying confidential terms, buyer data, identity documents or original agreement bytes into GitHub.
No separate renewal/continuation artifact surfaced in the checked connected Drive/Gmail search; this is not proof that no renewal exists.
Current inventory, current price/payment plan, detailed lead-protection rules, downstream partner right and downstream media scope remain unresolved for operational release.
Existing expo QR encodes https://wegc.fund/mira/start/ and the discovery path is Phuket-first.

Current /mira/start/ and /mira/access/ source still says working intake is closed, while the newer AGENCY-INTAKE-OPERATIONS handoff records owner-approved invite-only controlled agency intake. This is a source/content reconciliation defect, not evidence of a site outage.
decisions: Use VIVI as the first one-project Phuket commercial acceptance dossier; do not treat the 618-record research catalogue as sellable supply.
Keep confidential developer agreement fields in private operational storage; public GitHub stores only evidence/gap state.

For the exhibition journey, preserve public discovery but make the final agency next step truthful to the invite-only controlled-intake model; do not equate QR scan, local brief, Access login or application with activation.
